title: Understanding Cultural Alignment in Multilingual LLMs via Natural Debate Statements
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the models' sociocultural alignment according to Hofstede's cultural dimensions, using a dataset of natural debate statements. These statements cover a range of topics, including religion, to probe these values.
findings: The paper does not present specific findings related to religion. Religion is mentioned as one of several topics (along with politics, philosophy, science, and ethics) included in the 'Sociocultural Statements' dataset used to measure broader sociocultural alignment based on Hofstede's dimensions.
